'''Steven Lewis Monkey TIEs''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Steven Lewis]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds131.htm Monkey TIEs], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050303090825/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds131.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
